summary: Wisconsin's Commissioner of Insurance gave written notice on September 25, 2014 of a new basic loss ratio of 46% for credit life and new prima facie credit life rates for the three-year period beginning January 1, 2015. Single life: $0.42 per annum per $100 (single premium decreasing), $0.78 (level) and $0.647 per month per $1,000 (outstanding balance). Joint rates are 167% of single.
